criteria.description: An online worker with FIPSOverlayAddr and dns.projection.mesh_endpoints enabled projects a mesh endpoint and AAAA record in dns.projection.mesh_zone.
An online worker without FIPSOverlayAddr does not project a mesh DNS record.
A worker with FIPSOverlayAddr does not project a mesh DNS record when dns.projection.mesh_endpoints is false.
An unhealthy/offline worker with FIPSOverlayAddr does not project a mesh DNS record.
DNS config exposes dns.projection.mesh_endpoints and dns.projection.mesh_zone with safe defaults and validates mesh_zone when mesh endpoint projection is enabled.
